skins.name: Requiem
skins.costume: Black knee-length long SLEEVED leather coat, studded shoulders, black shirt, cargo trousers. Keep long coat silhouette and sleeves; no Rock vest.

skins.name: Rock
skins.costume: SLEEVELESS studded black leather VEST over skull graphic black shirt, muscular BARE upper arms, black cargo trousers. Gauntlets cover FOREARMS only. NO long coat, cape or sleeves.

forms.name: Normal

forms.name: Ruptura
forms.palette: Brown hair with RED tips/streaks; RED crystal costume trim. Saturated BRIGHT SCARLET energy at fists/forearms/shins/boots and strike trails. Keep face/eyes/skin unchanged.

forms.name: Eclipse
forms.palette: Brown hair with PURPLE tips/streaks and PURPLE crystal costume trim. Saturated VIOLET aura/trails, never red hair/crystals. Keep RED irises, clean warm skin, black clothes.

forms.name: Absoluto
forms.palette: SILVER-WHITE voluminous wavy hair, SAME LENGTH as the user's back-view reference: ends at UPPER/MID BACK above the belt/waist, roughly lower shoulder blades. NO waist-length hair, ponytail, twin tails, floor-length or cape-like white hair. Silver costume piping/hardware. PEARL-WHITE energy with ICY BLUE edges, RED irises, clean warm peach skin.
